caveats: HC11 is a SINGLE biological sample. Per-cluster DA lacks biological replication, so the DA-peak axis here is NOT certifying for de-alpha. ARIA cluster c2 alone produced ~9,900 wilcoxon-significant peaks (a single-sample power artifact). A multi-replicate scATAC dataset (donor-level pseudobulk) is required to certify the DA lane.

DA comparison is like-for-like: ARIA reported marker peaks (top-N per cluster, n=41 unique) vs SnapATAC2 marker_regions (n=74). An earlier revision mistakenly scored ARIA full significant-DA dump (~13,294) vs SnapATAC2 markers, a set-size confound that read ~chance (recall 0.27); this revision fixes that. Like-for-like marker overlap on HC11 is ~0.
Cluster axis is the trustworthy HC11 signal: ARI 0.532 / NMI 0.669 with 85-99% bidirectional cluster purity (the ARI penalty is granularity, not disagreement).
Motif axis null: SnapATAC2 CIS-BP vs ARIA JASPAR2024 namespace mismatch + local Ensembl-named genome vs UCSC chr* peaks.
messages: P3a scores ARIA scATAC outputs against an external tool's outputs (cluster ARI/NMI, DA-peak genomic overlap, motif top-k/RBO). It is execution/concordance evidence, NOT a de-alpha of the scATAC modality.
